articles.summary: The Hillshire Brands Company is voluntarily recalling select State Fair Corn Dogs on a Stick and Jimmy Dean Pancakes & Sausage on a Stick.
articles.title: Select Corn Dogs on a Stick and Pancakes & Sausage on a Stick Voluntarily Recalled

articles.summary: Introducing Tyson® Chicken Cups from Tyson Foods: 30 grams of protein per cup, convenient microwavable snacks perfect for busy, on-the-go lifestyles.
articles.title: Tyson Foods Launches Tyson® Chicken Cups – Convenient and Portable with 30g Protein or More

articles.summary: Tyson Foods’ has committed to expanded efforts for a better workplace at its production facilities for their focus on sustainable food production.
articles.title: Tyson Foods Plans to Stop Using High Fructose Corn Syrup and Other Ingredients in Its Branded Products

articles.summary: Tyson® brand is inspiring fans with new culinary innovations that celebrate fandom and inspire a protein-packed tailgate this football season. Tyson Foods is excited to announce three new chicken nugget offerings inspired by iconic football franchises.
articles.title: Three New Football Fandoms Join the Tyson Custom Nugget Line-up

articles.summary: Tyson Foods, Inc. announced the appointment of Devin Cole as Chief Operating Officer (COO). As COO, Devin will oversee the company’s business segments, including Poultry, Beef, Pork, Prepared Foods and International.
articles.title: Tyson Foods Announces Executive Leadership Appointment
